verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is an API endpoint that creates a rating for a candidate, plus a stages endpoint that returns the pipeline stages. Together they show some candidate evaluation exists alongside defined stages, but nothing shows structured scorecards. missing for 10: scorecards with defined attributes per stage, per-interviewer focused rubrics, side-by-side candidate comparison of scores, first-party product docs on structured interviews, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
